snapshot.hint: Month-over-month cost needs monthly snapshots. Without them the report looks empty when really the input is missing.

title: Cost overview
unattributedEnv: These hosts have no environment set (PROD/UAT…). Fill it in on the host record so they can be split here.
unattributedProject: These costs are not attributed to any business project yet. Business projects are the dictionary used for cost attribution — create them under Admin → Basic settings and assign hosts to them. (Note: this is NOT the same as the GCP project on the host.)
unpricedNote_one: {{count}} host has no matching rate and counts as 0 — it is not free, we simply cannot price it
unpricedNote_other: {{count}} hosts have no matching rate and count as 0 — they are not free, we simply cannot price them
idleDefinitionNote: Idle = actually paid − already allocated by request. This part is bought but not requested by any workload; it is the upper bound of what scaling down can save. Calibrate requests first, then shrink nodes.
